notes:
Initial qualification focused on Private VPC deployment. Prospect: BridgePoint builds AI assistants and search for rail logistics and requires strict EU data residency for PII and telemetry. Key quote from CISO: "No data may leave EU control plane or persistent storage; audit trail must be immutable."

What we learned:
- Security review kickoff 2026-02-22 (Fireflies ff_2026-02-22-bridgepoint-eval).
- Primary concern: KMS integration with customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) + HSM compatibility.
- Also: audit logging retention 7 years for some regulated telemetry flows.
- Prefers VPC peering to avoid public internet egress; will consider Private Link if available.
- Wants model inference to run in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 only; no cross-region backups without opt-in.

Sales notes / shorthand:
- AE flagged as enterprise opportunity; budget sizing asked (expect $200k-500k ARR).
- Legal: needs data residency clause + SOC2 attestation attached.
- Infra team requires detailed VPC topology, SGs, NAT/egress and allowed outbound CIDRs.

Customer asks:
- Can Redwood private run in an isolated VPC with customer-controlled subnets? -> Yes, need to provide diagrams.
- How is audit-log ingestion surfaced to their SIEM (Splunk)? -> Std: push via secure forwarder + S3 w/ MFA Delete; they requested sample retention policy.
- KMS: require CMK rotation policy + audit key-access logs (CloudTrail).

Outcome so far: demo passed for architects; now moving to detailed architecture fit and security deep-dive (requested week-of Mar 10).

Short term next steps:
- Deliver VPC topology doc (done, in Drive).
- Provide sample network ACLs, SGs, and egress CIDR list for approval.
- Draft contractual language for EU-only residency and audit log retention.

Probing items to resolve:
- Confirm whether Private Link or VPC Peering will be easiest for their network team.
- Confirm whether they will accept Redwood-managed KMS in dedicated partition or insist on external HSM (customer leaning to external HSM for Prod).
- How to handle debug telemetry that sometimes crosses regions (need a plan to de-identify locally).
